test_title: PYST 2: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 10 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Six girls D, K, M, P, R and S are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre. S is sitting third to the left of R. P is sitting to the immediate right of R and to the immediate left of D. M is sitting to the immediate left of R. K is sitting to the immediate right of S and to the immediate left of M. Who is the immediate neighbour of K and D?
solution: **Given : ** • Six girls - D, K, M, P, R and S • All of them are sitting around a circular table. • All of them are facing the centre. **Explanation : ** 1) S is sitting third to the left of R. 2) P is sitting to the immediate right of R and to the immediate left of D.
